input.title: ARDEX A 30 Slump free feather edge patching compound
input.descriptionHtml:
ARDEX A 30 is a slump free feather edge patching compound that is designed for internal filling of cavities, holes, unevenness and patching work in wall and floor areas. When mixed with water the result is a smooth slump free mortar with a pot life of approximately 15 minutes. ARDEX A 30 dries fast through hydration to a virtually tension free compound.

Floor Coverings:

  • Linoleum, vinyl, carpet
  • Ceramic and quarry tiles
  • Timber – parquetry and floating

Substrates:

  • New and existing concrete
  • Concrete masonry or cement render
  • Impervious surfaces primed with ARDEX P 82

Key features

  • Levelling and repairing of steps and landings
  • Can be applied to featheredge
  • Rapid hardening

Technical data

Location:

  • Internal – Filling cavities, holes unevenness, grooves, patching work in wall and floor areas
  • Levelling and repairing of stairs and landings
  • To produce ramps and smoothing of floor surfaces and ramps

Working Time: Approximately 15 minutes

Thickness: 0-20mm in one application

Drying & Curing: Sets in approximately 15 minutes; Subsequent levelling work should be done approximately 60 minutes after application

Packaging: 20kg triple layered bag

input.title: ARDEX A 38 Rapid Set Screed Cement

  • Bonded screed
  • Unbonded screed (on a slipsheet or insulating layer)
  • As a heated screeds

Floor Coverings:

  • Tiles
  • Natural Stones
  • Terrazzo tiles
  • Resilient and textile floorcoverings
  • Parquet

Substrates:

  • New and existing concrete

Key features

  • Fast track - Ready to receive tiles, natural stone and Terrazzo tiles after 8 hours
  • Dimensionally stable - Tension and shrinkage free
  • Can be used in bonded and un-bonded applications

ARDEX BR 340 is a high-build patching mortar and is capable of being applied up to a thickness of 80mm on vertical, horizontal, and overhead surfaces.

ARDEX BR 340 is designed to be used in conjunction with ARDEX BRX 60 LO Anodes for ultimate corrosion control and cathodic prevention.

  • Polymer modified
  • Shrinkage compensated
  • Low resistivity (<10,000 Ω cm)
  • Contains active corrosion inhibitor
  • High build applications – up to 80mm thickness
  • Suitable for use with ARDEX BRX 60 LO Anodes

Key features

  • Low resistivity
  • Contains active corrosion inhibitor
  • Polymer modified & shrinkage compensated

input.title: ARDEX EG 800 F Multi-Purpose Epoxy System
input.descriptionHtml:
ARDEX EG 800 F is a high performance multi-purpose epoxy system designed for environments that may require strict standards of hygiene, high chemical, and physical resistance.

Features

  • For tile grouting all natural stone and terrazzo
  • Used with ARDEX Floor Leveller Primer Sand, the ARDEX EG 800 F can be used for a variety of epoxy mortar applications
  • Used with ARDEX Gravel Mix, the ARDEX EG 800 F becomes a stable epoxy based screed
  • Used with ARDEX Aggregate 5/2mm, the ARDEX EG 800 F becomes an effective epoxy drainage screed

Key features

  • High chemical and physical resistance
  • High performance epoxy system designed for a variety of applications
  • Combining with selected ARDEX fillers to produce epoxy mortars/screeds

Technical data

Uses: For tile grouting all natural stone and terrazzo.; NOTE: Porous, moisture sensitive, and textured tiles may require special application procedures. Contact ARDEX Technical Services (technicalservices@ardexaustralia.com).

When combined with ARDEX Floor Leveller Primer Sand to create various consistencies, the ARDEX EG 800 F can be used for a variety of epoxy mortar applications such as waterproofing membrane terminations, or as a fast and effective epoxy patch repair.

When combined with ARDEX Gravel Mix, the ARDEX EG 800 F becomes a stable epoxy based screed with good workability and high strength.

When combined with ARDEX Aggregate 5/2mm, the ARDEX EG 800 F becomes an effective epoxy drainage screed with good compressive strength.

Packaging:

  • ARDEX EG 800 F Part A – 8L
  • ARDEX EG 800 F Part B – 4L
  • ARDEX EG 800 F Part C – 15kg ARDEX Colour Pack

NOTE: ARDEX EG 800 F Part C not required for epoxy mortar / screed / drainage screed applications.

input.title: ARDEX Concrete Crack Lock Carbon-Fibre Crack Bridging Stitch
input.descriptionHtml:
The Rhino Concrete Crack Lock (CCL) is a revolutionary new product that was developed to improve concrete crack repair. The CCL is installed by making a single blade-width cut across the crack and drilling two holes along the cut at the appropriate locations. Once the preparation is complete and free of dust, it is filled with an approved ARDEX Epoxy Paste such as ARDEX RA 88 (for vertical applications) or ARDEX RA 142, ARDEX RA 144 or ARDEX RA 146 (for horizontal applications) and the CCL is inserted. Once installed, the CCL permanently bonds both sides of the crack together. Due to the unique shape of the CCL and the preparation in the concrete, the tensile strength of the carbon fibre is relied upon as well as the epoxy bond strength along its length.

Benefits:

  • High Strength
